tasks.title: Implement 3-layer memory write enforcement
tasks.description: Helper scripts + CLAUDE.md triggers + cross-session debt hook
tasks.outcome: Created 4 helper scripts in .claude/scripts/ (add-decision.sh, add-task.sh, add-pattern.sh, update-context.sh). Added 5 mandatory trigger events to CLAUDE.md with format templates and timing rules. Built cross-session debt hook: on-session-stop.sh detects empty semantic files and writes .memory-debt.md; on-user-prompt.sh at next session start injects the reminder then deletes it. Enforcement fires exactly once per missed session — no repeated nagging.

tasks.title: Update documentation for memory enforcement
tasks.outcome: Updated quick-reference.md with memory trigger table (when/what/how to write). Updated tools-usage-guide.md with script invocation examples for all 4 helper scripts. Updated changelog.md with Phase 3.6 entry documenting 3-layer enforcement and cross-session debt pattern. All docs linked from MEMORY.md index.

tasks.title: Fix Session Activity prompts not rendering in modal
tasks.description: Fix Session Activity prompts not rendering in modal
tasks.outcome: Root cause: onclick='openSessionModal(${JSON.stringify(s).replace(/"/g, """)})' — user prompts containing quotes, newlines, or JSON silently corrupted the JS object in the HTML attribute. Fix applied in dashboard.html: (1) added window._safetyTabSessions = reversed before .map(), (2) changed onclick to pass numeric index i, (3) updated openSessionModal to check typeof s === 'number' and retrieve window._safetyTabSessions[i]. Removed the old encoded approach entirely. All prompts now render regardless of special characters.

tasks.title: Implement per-file line counts with heat-map colors
tasks.description: Implement per-file line counts with heat-map colors
tasks.outcome: track-usage.sh: replaced git diff --name-only + string array with git diff --numstat HEAD + jq object loop producing {path, added, removed} per file (max 20). Binary files return '-' from numstat — handled with tonumber? // 0. dashboard.html: heat-map background colors applied per file in SAFETY tab modal — green rgba(16,185,129,0.08) for <10 total lines, yellow rgba(245,158,11,0.12) for 10–50, red rgba(239,68,68,0.12) for >50, purple rgba(139,92,246,0.15) for rewrites (>200 or removed/added>70%). Old string[] session entries still render filename-only — backwards compatible.

tasks.title: Debug 'Loading session history...' — sessionsEl null issue
tasks.description: Debug Loading session history — sessionsEl null issue
tasks.outcome: Symptom: stats row correctly showed '43 sessions, 467 files' but the session list div stayed as static placeholder text. Debug steps: (1) added try-catch around sessionsEl.innerHTML assignment with inline error display in red, (2) added debug line to safetyLastUpdated div showing 'el=found|not-found | n=count'. Debug output showed el=found, n=43 — element reachable and data present. Root cause confirmed: old JSON-in-onclick render threw a runtime JS error before assigning innerHTML. New index-based onclick code resolved it. Container restarted, sessions rendered correctly. Debug lines removed post-fix.
